Platform limits

Windows-only cases are not registered on macOS. “Not built locally” does not mean passed. Linux, mobile platforms and Windows were not run in this session.

Build limits

Release removes the console implementation by default; Debug exercises the real output path. Profiler tests require an explicit build option. Sanitizers were not run in this session.

Validation limits

No line or branch coverage was generated. Process-kill cases check recovery after process termination, not power-loss durability. The build emitted existing warnings; see the raw logs.

04 / REPRODUCE

Commands and CI configuration

Run these commands from the repository root. The recorded runs used isolated temporary build directories and did not modify project source.

macOS · CMake / CTest

# Run from the repository root; include optional profiler tests
cmake -S Core -B build/core-debug \
  -DMXLOGGER_BUILD_TESTS=ON -DMXLOGGER_BUILD_PROFILE=ON \
  -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug
cmake --build build/core-debug --parallel
ctest --test-dir build/core-debug --output-on-failure --no-tests=error

# Use a separate build directory for Release
cmake -S Core -B build/core-release \
  -DMXLOGGER_BUILD_TESTS=ON -DMXLOGGER_BUILD_PROFILE=ON \
  -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
cmake --build build/core-release --parallel
ctest --test-dir build/core-release --output-on-failure --no-tests=error

Windows · MSVC x64

# PowerShell; requires Visual Studio C++ tools and CMake
cmake -S Core -B build/windows-core -A x64 `
  -DMXLOGGER_BUILD_TESTS=ON -DMXLOGGER_BUILD_PROFILE=ON
cmake --build build/windows-core --config Debug --parallel
ctest --test-dir build/windows-core -C Debug --output-on-failure --no-tests=error
cmake --build build/windows-core --config Release --parallel
ctest --test-dir build/windows-core -C Release --output-on-failure --no-tests=error
Existing shell script and sanitizer options
# Existing script: core tests only; excludes test_profile.cpp
bash Core/tests/run_tests.sh

# Optional: these sanitizer configurations were not run for this report
SAN=address bash Core/tests/run_tests.sh
SAN=thread bash Core/tests/run_tests.sh
VERBOSE=1 bash Core/tests/run_tests.sh

run_tests.sh explicitly keeps console and diagnostic output, filtering library diagnostic lines by default. Core tests reset mxtest_tmp in their working directory at startup and retain it afterward for inspection.

This describes the current source configuration, not the latest GitHub Actions outcome. No push or pull_request triggers are configured.

Lightweight self-registering framework

MX_TEST in mx_test.hpp registers functions. EXPECT_TRUE, EXPECT_FALSE and EXPECT_EQ count individual assertions. No external test framework is required.

Located failures; empty runs fail

Failures report the expression, source file and line number; uncaught exceptions count as failures. The runner fails if no cases are registered, and CTest uses --no-tests=error.

Process tests and isolation

macOS uses posix_spawn and Windows uses CreateProcessW, coordinated with pipe barriers. CTest sets a 180-second timeout for the Core entry.

1//2//  mxlogger_build_config.h3//  MXLoggerCore4//5//  开发期输出(控制台输出 / debug_log)的编译期开关。6//  Compile-time switches for development-time output (console output / debug_log).7//89#ifndef mxlogger_build_config_h10#define mxlogger_build_config_h1112/// 这次构建是否保留"开发期输出"。发布构建下相关代码整段不会被编译进产物。13///14/// 各平台判据不同，原因是"谁在什么时候编译这段C++"不一样:15///   * iOS/macOS: pod源码集成，跟着宿主工程编译。Xcode/CocoaPods 只在 Debug 配置定义16///     DEBUG=1，Release/Profile 都不定义 NDEBUG，所以只能用 DEBUG 判定。17///   * Linux/Windows: CMake 的 Release/RelWithDebInfo/MinSizeRel 与 MSVC 的 Release18///     都会定义 NDEBUG(MSVC 的 Debug 定义 _DEBUG，不会命中)。19///   * Android: 发的是预编译 aar，C++ 只在打包时编译一次，那次必然带 -DNDEBUG。若在此裁剪，20///     使用方的 debug 构建也会永久失去输出，因此 Android 一律保留，由运行时开关控制。21///22/// 两个需要显式覆盖的场景:23///   * 想在发布包里保留输出(灰度/QA包): 宿主 target 加 MXLOGGER_CONSOLE_ENABLED=124///     或 MXLOGGER_DEBUG_LOG_ENABLED=1；25///   * 直接用 clang++/g++ 手搓编译(不带任何配置宏)时，Apple 平台会判定为发布构建而裁掉，26///     需要输出就加 -DDEBUG=1 或单独打开上面两个宏(Core/tests 就是这么做的)。27///28/// Whether this build keeps "development-time output". In release builds the corresponding29/// code is left out of the binary entirely.30///31/// The signal differs per platform because "who compiles this C++, and when" differs:32///   * iOS/macOS: integrated from source via CocoaPods and compiled with the host project.33///     Xcode/CocoaPods only define DEBUG=1 in the Debug configuration and never define34///     NDEBUG, so DEBUG is the only usable signal.35///   * Linux/Windows: CMake's Release/RelWithDebInfo/MinSizeRel and MSVC's Release all36///     define NDEBUG (MSVC's Debug defines _DEBUG instead and does not match).37///   * Android: ships as a prebuilt aar whose C++ is compiled once at packaging time, always38///     with -DNDEBUG. Stripping there would permanently kill the output in the consumer's39///     debug build too, so Android always keeps it and stays runtime-gated.40///41/// Two cases that need an explicit override:42///   * keeping the output in a release build (QA/beta): define MXLOGGER_CONSOLE_ENABLED=143///     or MXLOGGER_DEBUG_LOG_ENABLED=1 in the host target;44///   * compiling by hand with clang++/g++ without any configuration macro: Apple platforms45///     then look like a release build and strip it — pass -DDEBUG=1, or turn the two46///     switches above on individually (this is what Core/tests does).47#ifndef MXLOGGER_DEV_OUTPUT_ENABLED48    #if defined(__ANDROID__)49        #define MXLOGGER_DEV_OUTPUT_ENABLED 150    #elif defined(NDEBUG)51        #define MXLOGGER_DEV_OUTPUT_ENABLED 052    #elif defined(__APPLE__) && !defined(DEBUG) && !defined(_DEBUG)53        #define MXLOGGER_DEV_OUTPUT_ENABLED 054    #else55        #define MXLOGGER_DEV_OUTPUT_ENABLED 156    #endif57#endif5859/// 控制台输出(mxlogger_console)开关。关闭时 enable_console_ 的判断、gen_console_str、60/// cJSON 解析/打印都不会被编译进产物，set_enable_console 退化为只记标记。61/// Switch for console output (mxlogger_console). When off, the enable_console_ check,62/// gen_console_str and the cJSON parse/print are all left out of the binary, and63/// set_enable_console only records the flag.64#ifndef MXLOGGER_CONSOLE_ENABLED65    #define MXLOGGER_CONSOLE_ENABLED MXLOGGER_DEV_OUTPUT_ENABLED66#endif6768/// 库自身诊断输出(debug_log)开关。关闭时 MXLoggerInfo 整条展开为空语句，69/// MXLoggerError 仍会调用并返回错误文案(error_record/errorDesc 依赖它)，只是不输出。70/// Switch for the library's own diagnostics (debug_log). When off, MXLoggerInfo expands to71/// an empty statement, while MXLoggerError is still called and still returns its message72/// (error_record/errorDesc depend on it) — only the printing is skipped.73#ifndef MXLOGGER_DEBUG_LOG_ENABLED74    #define MXLOGGER_DEBUG_LOG_ENABLED MXLOGGER_DEV_OUTPUT_ENABLED75#endif7677#endif /* mxlogger_build_config_h */
